Widget Screen - hardware sensors: third-party notices
=====================================================

The files in this folder are not part of Widget Screen's own code. They are the
unmodified library files of LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6 and the libraries it needs,
taken from the official release:

  https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/releases/tag/v0.9.6
  LibreHardwareMonitor.zip, SHA-256 086d9f1b5a99e643edc2cfaaac16051685b551e4c5ac0b32a57c58c0e529c001

Widget Screen checks every file's SHA-256 before it loads it. Setup can leave
them out ("Install hardware sensors"); Widget Screen then runs without them.

CPU temperatures also need the PawnIO driver (https://pawnio.eu) and Widget
Screen's full-sensors mode. Widget Screen and its setup never install PawnIO.
